description:
[Calculators] Rust crosshair presets, styles and colours (the in-game crosshair editor's codes). The data behind https://rust.wiki/crosshair: Rust's built-in crosshair editor (Options > User Interface >
Crosshair, since October 2025) shares crosshairs as codes like `RUST-FceIG-V4T`. `presets` are ready-made
crosshairs with their codes and settings; `styles`, `colors` and `outline_colors` are the editor's choices
(index = the value in a code); `ranges` are the sliders' min, max and step. Build or read a code with
/crosshair/code.
name: get_crosshair_presets
title: Rust crosshair presets, styles and colours (the in-game crosshair editor's codes)
